canonical_json.object_key_order: ascending Unicode scalar value; fixed ASCII schema keys
canonical_json.string_encoding: raw Unicode scalar values except quote/backslash and U+0000..001F; quote/backslash use backslash escapes; backspace/tab/LF/formfeed/CR use \b/\t/\n/\f/\r; remaining controls use lowercase \u00xx; no slash/HTML escaping
canonical_json.normalization: none; reject unpaired surrogates, invalid UTF-8, duplicate keys
canonical_json.numbers: only unsigned integer tokens 0..9007199254740991; no bool-as-int, floats, exponent, negative zero, NaN or infinity
canonical_json.arrays: retain wire order; set arrays canonicalized only at publication as specified in README

hash_preimages.row_sha256: C(entire row excluding only its own top-level row_sha256)
hash_preimages.envelope_sha256: C(entire envelope excluding only its own top-level envelope_sha256); retain row hashes and all timestamps
hash_preimages.projection_revision: C(projection_revision_preimage in this file); no timestamps, host paths or self-hash

ordering.comparison: ascending unsigned UTF-8 bytes; no normalization, locale or case fold

cursor.consumer: OPAQUE; echo unchanged, never decode or synthesize
cursor.filter_hash: SHA-256(C(dataset filter_preimage)); scope/dataset/revision bind separately; limit excluded so page size may change
cursor.validation_order: canonical encoding/size/version/zero fields/UTF-8 and lengths; dataset/type/scope/revision/filter binding; then snapshot
cursor.authority: unsigned bounded data; parameterized indexed SQL only, no SQL/path authority

query_validation.proxy: exact path allowlist + target length cap and HTTP framing only
query_validation.decode: strict UTF-8 percent decoding exactly once; plus is space; reject malformed encodings, duplicate/repeated/unknown names and blank values
query_validation.scope: required exact configured scope_id; unknown/mismatched scope gives 400 INVALID_QUERY
query_validation.limit: optional canonical decimal 1..50, default 25; no plus/leading zeros/whitespace
query_validation.cursor: optional opaque base64url; owner validates binding; malformed gives INVALID_CURSOR
query_validation.disabled_dataset_precedence: A-only publication retains the A disabled precedence; B-enabled publication validates each B route normally before warm admission.

forwarded: Retry-After only on 503, validated as above

upstream_content_encoding: identity only; reject compressed upstream before committing headers

projection_transport.saturation: parsed request: 503 PROJECTION_BUSY / Retry-After: 1; pre-accept OS overflow may refuse/reset/timeout

delta.normalization: Exact decimal value of the original admitted native JSON number token; expand exponent, strip trailing fractional zeroes and redundant sign, zero is 0. No binary64 round trip or arithmetic. Producer canonical output normalizes zero and fractional padding; grammar also accepts -0 and 1.0. Display rounding is UI-title-only.
delta.failure: Whole comparison null with OMITTED_CONTENT; preserve owner admission and suppress verdict presentation.
delta.match_semantics: Whole string, no trimming, no multiline flags; final negative lookahead forbids every following scalar including LF in both Python and ECMAScript.

stage_b_delta.comparison_window: Native frozen-window string or native ordered ISO-boundary strings, byte-preserved. Not the epoch-ms RowScope.Window. Never rebuild owner comparison_group from wire-transformed conditions.
stage_b_delta.ordering: Inherited UTF8_RECORD_ID_ASC_V1; immutable idea_revision ID / assessment node ID / native paper campaign_id.
stage_b_delta.capability: All six descriptors read=true; all mutating capabilities remain false; recall NOT_EVALUATED; D07/D12 off.
stage_b_delta.activation: New scope_sha256 (enabled_datasets includes all seven routes), projection_revision and snapshot_id. Rebuild publication/index receipts as one owner generation; this document authorizes no publication.
stage_b_delta.campaign_predicate_override: Supersedes design section 3.1 autonomous-campaign predicate and section 3.3 campaign row for Stage B only. Support research_knowledge.paper_campaign.v1, with frozen preregistration experiment-parent membership. Do not require or fabricate autonomous state chains. Autonomous campaigns remain a supported disjoint chain type, with zero rows in scope. Missing paper seals produce PARTIAL / PREREGISTRATION_SEAL_MISSING, never a fabricated seal. Existing seal integrity failures make the campaigns envelope UNAVAILABLE with the owner reason.
stage_b_delta.empty_assessments_ui: no recorded assessments for this revision
stage_b_delta.row_region_contract: row-regions-stage-b.json; README-stage-b.md item 6; assessment-only redistribution preserves row8192 and response224000.
stage_b_delta.stage_a_produced: UNSUPPORTED_NATIVE_SCHEMA; frozen v1 Stage A is unchanged.
stage_b_delta.artifact_produced_targets: Native evidence:<digest> IDs are exact opaque Stage-A OUT_OF_SCOPE refs; do not project a new node type.
